title: Benchmark suite selection and phase orchestration
objective: Provide a machine-checkable suite manifest that selects completed phase evidence without coupling orchestration policy to theorem source code.

in_scope: M0-M3 suite selection and replay lineage

deliverables.name: Suite manifest
deliverables.acceptance: Declare the included completed phases and their evidence oracles as data.

deliverables.name: Independent selector
deliverables.acceptance: Reject missing, non-ready or mismatched phase evidence without invoking theorem policy.

deliverables.name: Selection negative corpus
deliverables.acceptance: Reject temporary suite manifest and readiness mutations.

deliverables.name: Deterministic suite replay
deliverables.acceptance: Emit hash-bound suite evidence from the locked local profile.

deliverables.name: M4 readiness gate
deliverables.acceptance: Produce a machine-checkable readiness report for the next benchmark phase.
